Description: World-famous archaeologist and adventurer, Lara Croft, the legendary Tomb Raider. Born Lara Amelia Croft in Wimbledon, London, her parents died when she was young, leaving Lara to inherit their massive fortune, including an estate and the title of Countess of Abbingdon. She resides in her luxurious estate of Croft Manor. At the age of 21, she underwent an experience that changed her life as her chartered plane crashed in the Himalayas. Using her wits and skills, Lara managed to survive and return to civilization. However, this had a profound effect on Lara, leaving her unable to stand stuffy, upper-crust British society, and over the next nine years she discovered her passion for adventuring across the globe. She's made a name for herself as a writer of her exploits, published author, archaeologist and international sex symbol. Lara has hunted for numerous legendary artifacts including the Spear of Destiny, the Dagger of Xian and Amulet of Horus explored Atlantis, the Tomb of Tutankhamun and Area 51.
